scope: Frontier safety frameworks collection (version 2): archive captures recorded for 27 sources (26 sources cited by the collection's 49 claims plus edition source source-fsf-1-0), source language tags (all 181 sources), and the one evidence passage changed from paraphrase to quote. No claim, ID, claim date or editorial state changed.

proposingPass.method: Wayback CDX listing of status-200 captures of each recorded evidence URL; nearest capture to the edition's effective, else publication, else revision date (source publication date for announcements; recorded access date for mutable index pages with no publication date). No snapshot was created. PDF captures compared with currently served bytes (SHA-1 digest, then pdftotext text diff where different). Quote candidates limited to sources whose reuse note permits minimal attributed excerpts.

auditor.agent: Fresh-context subagent, Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5), launched from the proposing session
auditor.method: Given only a bounded packet of records (no proposer verdicts or byte comparisons); retrieved live originals and archive captures itself (curl, CDX, id_ replay, pdftotext, text and byte comparison). Did not read the repository and created no snapshots.
auditor.independence: Same model family and machine as the proposing pass; execution independence is not established.

random.method: mulberry32 PRNG, seed 20261003, draws without replacement from ID-sorted pools

targeted.reasons: Byte differences between capture and current file, redirect-only capture, captures long after publication, mutable index pages, date-label ambiguity, the changed and existing quotes, an inferred comparison claim, and every non-English or bilingual-risk source.

coverage.archiveRecords: 17 of 27 audited (8 random, 9 targeted); the proposing pass compared all 17 archived PDFs with current bytes
coverage.evidence: 13 of the collection's 65 evidence records audited (8 random, 5 targeted), including the one changed record
coverage.language: 23 of 181 source tags audited (12 random, 11 targeted), including all 10 non-English sources
coverage.quotes: 3 of 65 collection evidence records cite sources whose reuse note permits excerpts; 2 were already quotes and 1 paraphrase was upgraded. The other 62 keep paraphrases because their reuse notes do not permit excerpts.

findings.issue: Mutable source. The ARC Evals acknowledgement paragraph is absent from the 14:15 and 16:17 UTC captures of 2023-09-19 at the page's earlier /index/ address and present from 20:15 UTC.
findings.checked: Auditor finding reproduced by the proposing pass: six publication-day and next-day captures replayed.
findings.disposition: The quote is verbatim and does not contradict the claim or the prior paraphrase. The timing is recorded in the evidence verification note. Claim unchanged; maintainer triage on whether the qualification should state that the credit was added on the day of publication.

findings.issue: The current file differs from the 2025-02-05 capture. It adds a publisher-documented link correction (21 March 2025), corrects a surname spelling and moves a footnote.
findings.checked: Proposer and auditor text diffs agree.
findings.disposition: Archive keeps the original text. Evidence was inspected on the current file; the cited title and date passage are unaffected.

findings.issue: The current file was silently copy-edited under the same date label. It removes a duplicated 'Value alignment' sentence in C.2 and adds commas after 'e.g.'.
findings.checked: Proposer and auditor text diffs agree; cited p. 15 changelog text is identical.

findings.issue: CDX digests differ only through stored gzip transfer encoding; decompressed bytes are identical to the current file. The PDF itself shows no date or edition label.
The recorded URL has only redirect captures. The stored capture (2026-02-24 20:30:46 UTC) replays to the RSP v3.0 PDF captured five seconds later, byte-identical to the current redirect target.
findings.disposition: Redirect capture retained as the archive link; maintainer decision invited.

findings.issue: Earlier captures exist at predecessor addresses (anthropic.com/index/..., deepmind.google/discover/blog/..., www-files.anthropic.com, assets.anthropic.com), closer to publication than any capture of the recorded URL. Identical bytes were confirmed for rsp-1-0 (2023-09-19) and rsp-2-0 (2024-10-22).
findings.checked: Auditor CDX and replay; proposer CDX for the DeepMind announcement.
findings.disposition: Not substituted: the stored link stays a capture of the recorded URL. Maintainer decision invited.

findings.issue: Auditor agreed but suggested closer paraphrase wording. The changelog entries do not name the predecessor version; the RSP v1.0 text says 'in the spirit of' rather than 'draw on'.
findings.disposition: Not changed in this task (paraphrase-only sources); candidates for a later wording pass.

retrievalFailures.detail: HTTP 403 to a minimal user agent; succeeded with browser headers.
pdftotext could not extract text (Adobe-CNS1 fonts); the auditor judged the script from embedded ToUnicode maps instead.
One alternate-digest capture (2026-04-08) replays as Wayback HTML, not a PDF; not examined.

limits: A bounded sample does not certify unsampled records. Capture dates are UTC Wayback timestamps. The Internet Archive was taken as a faithful witness of what it retrieved. Not every byte-variant capture was replayed. Script judgements for Chinese use character inventories, not a classifier. Machine agreement is neither historical certainty nor human review; no evidence verification or editorial state changed.

archiveChanges.basis: Capture made at the file’s earlier address (www-files.anthropic.com) on the effective date. Its bytes are identical to the inspected file (SHA-1 1adf000c8f675958c2ee23805d91aaade1cd4613, matching the recorded URL’s path).

Capture made at the file’s earlier address (assets.anthropic.com) seven days after the effective date. Its bytes are identical to the inspected file (SHA-1 616dee633636e5bd309cb73aed8622e80fe47839). Later captures at that address (from 2024-11-01) hold a different variant, which is not linked.

followUp.unchanged: The RSP v3.0 redirect capture and the announcement pages’ links to captures of their recorded URLs are kept.
